title: 第2章 角色附体
content_zh:
展飞也是愣了一下，然后把账号密码重新输入了一遍，得到的依然是同样的提示，而展飞也是气的直接把电脑一合，然后躺在了床上，这个游戏，是他这么长时间以来的精神寄托，如今角色忽然没了，展飞也是感觉心里面十分的空落。

毕竟是玩了好几个月的游戏了，玩游戏，也是展飞这两年精力主要的所在了，而大多数学生也是如此，毕竟小学五年，初中三年，高中三年，学习了足足十一年了，除了个别人物，大家都对于学习厌烦了，展飞也同样如此。

而到了大学，各方面的管理都宽松了很多，所以上了大学和放了大假差不多，十一年的学习，然后忽然放假了，所有人都是疯了一样的玩，也只有少数的有理想有抱负有追求的精英人士人才会继续努力学习深造了。

很明显，展飞不属于这三有人才，他的大学宣言，是把自己的处男之身给破了，不过他暂时还没有成功，因为这里是博州理工，原本就是狼多肉少，而展飞在这些狼之中也仅仅是极为普通的一头。

虽然学校同样有着美女，不过和他连丑女都分不到一个，更别说美女了，展飞的两名室友同样如此，抢不到肉的狼，不能像那些杰出的狼一样，带着自己的猎物出去开房打针，只能窝在寝室里面玩玩游戏了。

展飞躺在床上，脑中YY着自己被学校某个女神看中，对方疯了一样的要让自己当他男朋友的情形，迷迷糊糊的，他似乎要睡着了，而梦中，自己也要给某个女神打针了。

不过正在这个时候，眼前，忽然出现了一个属性面板，有些迷糊的展飞也是一下子清醒了过来，怎么可能？自己不是闭着眼睛吗？怎么看到这玩意儿了？难道是做梦？

想着，展飞用力的睁开了眼睛，接着，眼前的那属性面板像是显示屏断电了一样，直接便暗了下去，然后一缕光线似乎出现了，接着，展飞便看到了天天在寝室里面几乎看烂了的天花板，接着，展飞用手在自己胳膊上掐了一下，疼！

那么，自己不是在做梦了？那那个属性面板究竟是怎么回事？幻觉吗？

想起来，那个面板貌似是自己在斗破大陆里面那个角色的属性啊，难道是自己想游戏想疯了？

不行不行，看来这玩意儿得戒啊，要是真有了什么毛病，老妈可怎么办啊，展飞从小，便没有见过自己的父亲，而从母亲的口中，也没有得到过什么信息。

不过从母亲的表情和语气，展飞能猜出来，那个男人并不是死了，而是不认账了，把展飞母子二人给抛弃了，而听说外公家里面当年也是劝母亲把自己给打掉，母亲不同意，执意把自己给生了下来，然后自己母子二人和母亲亲戚那边，走动也是不多。

故而，展飞可以说差不多只有母亲一个亲人了，所以有什么事情，展飞首先都要想想自己老妈，想到这个游戏可能给自己带来的影响，展飞直接便打开电脑，把游戏给卸载了。

然后口中有默默的念了几句南无阿弥陀佛，又加了几句哈利路亚，然后便再次闭上了眼睛，眼前，黑乎乎的一片，展飞也是微微松了一口气，一秒，两秒，三秒。

到了第三秒的时候，那个属性面板再次出现了，展飞心跳也是骤然加快了一倍，口中又念了几句波若波罗密，依然没有任何的效果，接着，展飞睁开了眼睛，画面再次消失，闭眼，三秒钟，属性面板再次出。

这回，展飞基本可以断定，自己应该不是有病，这面板，也不是幻觉，有谁听说过，幻觉会出现的这么准时规律的？每次闭眼三秒钟便会出现，如果不是病，那么，难道说，是超能力之类的？

展飞在博州理工，实在太过平凡了，连一块肉都枪不到，正是吃荤的年纪，都快把他给憋死了，故而对于可能让自己变得不平凡起来的这东西，展飞的兴趣很大，接着，他的目光便在这面板上面仔细的看了起来：

角色：展飞001，HP：60，MP：120

力量：5，体力：4，智力：8，敏捷：5，精力：6，

魔法攻击/防御：40/30，物理攻击/防御：10/8，命中/躲闪：10/10,

果然，这就是自己在斗破大陆里面的异人角色，只不过，原本八十九级的号码，如今变成了零级，各项属性也回归了原始的状态，在斗破大陆之中，不同战斗职业五维属性带来的增幅不同。

像是异人，智力和精力带来的魔法方面的增幅比较大，力量、敏捷、体力带来的物理方面的增幅比较少，而展飞在游戏之中的账号，也四智一精的方式分配点数。

不过看到了自己的几个属性，展飞却是想哭，这五项属性，满值都是十，自己除了智力和精力之外，全部都不及格，特别是体力，只有四点，自己的身体现在也太渣了吧？还有敏捷和力量也不过五点，处于一般人偏下的水准。

一般男性的身体素质，各方面都是六点属于普通，八点属于优秀，十点的话，那就是国家级的运动员水准了，超过十点，那就是博尔特、菲尔普斯那一类的外星人了。

目前展飞的属性，也只有智力还行，其他方面，因为大学两年长期的呆在寝室里面，已经有些退化了，看来，以后得好好锻炼了啊，看完了这几项属性，展飞又将目光放到了这个面板的其他地方。

面板的右上角，有着一个“商”字，那是斗破大陆的官方商城，整个游戏所需要的各种道具，里面都有的出售，而里面的道具，有的是用银两购买的，有的则是用元宝购买的，而在属性面板的右侧，则是一个包裹，包裹里面有着三十个空格，里面空空如也。

包裹的下方，写着展飞拥有的银两、银票、元宝、和元宝票，银两和元宝都是零，游戏开始赠送了一百两银票和二十元宝票，他们之间的区别的话，银两元宝可以用来和玩家交易，银票和元宝票的话，就只能和游戏官方交易了，是绑定的。

不过貌似在自己大脑里面玩这个游戏的，也只有展飞一个人了，所以，银两或者银票对他却是没有任何区别了。

而看完了这些，展飞的目光又放在了属性面板的下方，下方，有着五个选项，分别是任务系统、坐骑系统、灵兽系统、战斗职业、生活职业五个大类，任务系统空空如也，坐骑系统和灵兽系统，需要三十级才能开启，故而是暗灰色的，点不进去。

战斗职业同样需要十级才能开启，故而一样点不进去，只有生活职业能够点进去，而点进去之后，展飞的脸上也是露出了一丝喜色，自己如今一不能打怪，二没有任务，怎么升级？

所以那战斗职业以及灵兽、坐骑系统，可能根本没有，如果这生活技能也没法用的话，那么这个游戏角色附身，对于自己就没有任何帮助了，还好，生活职业可以用！
content_en:
Zhan Fei was stunned for a moment, and then re-entered his account and password. He still got the same prompt. Zhan Fei was so angry that he closed the computer and lay on the bed. This game had been his spiritual sustenance for such a long time. Now that the character was suddenly gone, Zhan Fei also felt very empty in his heart.

After all, he has been playing games for several months. Playing games has been the main focus of Zhan Fei's energy in the past two years, and the same is true for most students. After all, after five years of primary school, three years of junior high school, and three years of high school, he has been studying for eleven years. Except for a few people, everyone is tired of studying, and the same is true for Zhan Fei.

When you get to university, all aspects of management are much looser, so going to university is almost like taking a vacation. After eleven years of study, you suddenly have a vacation. Everyone is playing like crazy, and only a few elites with ideals, ambitions and pursuits will continue to study hard and further their studies.

Obviously, Zhan Fei does not belong to these three talented people. His university declaration was to break his virginity, but he has not succeeded yet, because this is Bozhou Institute of Technology, which originally has more wolves and less meat, and Zhan Fei is just an ordinary one among these wolves.

Although there are also beauties in the school, he can't even get an ugly one, let alone a beauty. The same is true for Zhan Fei's two roommates. Wolves who can't get meat can't take their prey out to rent a room for injections like those outstanding wolves. They can only stay in the dormitory and play games.

Zhan Fei was lying on the bed, imagining in his mind that he was spotted by a certain goddess in school, who wanted to be his boyfriend like crazy. In a daze, he seemed to be falling asleep, and in his dream, he was about to give an injection to a certain goddess.

But at this moment, an attribute panel suddenly appeared in front of him, and Zhan Fei, who was a little confused, suddenly woke up. How could it be possible?Don't you have your eyes closed?Why did you see this thing?Could it be a dream?

Thinking about it, Zhan Fei opened his eyes forcefully. Then, the attribute panel in front of him seemed to be out of power, and it went dark. Then a ray of light seemed to appear. Then, Zhan Fei saw the ceiling that was almost ruined every day in the dormitory. Then, Zhan Fei pinched his arm with his hand. It hurt!

So, aren't you dreaming?So what's going on with that property panel?Hallucination?

Come to think of it, that panel seems to be the attributes of my character in Dou Po Continent. Could it be that I am crazy about the game?

No, no, it seems like this thing needs to be quit. If something is really wrong, what will my mother do? Zhan Fei has never seen his father since he was a child, and he has not received any information from his mother.

However, from his mother's expression and tone, Zhan Fei could guess that the man was not dead, but that he refused to admit his guilt and abandoned Zhan Fei and his son. It was said that his grandfather's family also persuaded his mother to abort him, but his mother did not agree and insisted on giving birth to him. Then his mother and son and his mother's relatives did not move around much.

Therefore, it can be said that Zhanfei almost only has his mother as a relative, so if anything happens, Zhanfei must first think about his mother. Thinking of the impact this game may have on him, Zhanfei directly turns on the computer and uninstalls the game.

Then he silently recited a few words of Namo Amitabha, and added a few words of Hallelujah, and then closed his eyes again. His eyes were dark, and Zhan Fei also breathed a sigh of relief for one second, two seconds, three seconds.

At the third second, the attribute panel appeared again. Zhan Fei's heartbeat suddenly doubled. He recited a few more paramita in his mouth, but it still had no effect. Then, Zhan Fei opened his eyes, and the screen disappeared again. After closing his eyes, for three seconds, the attribute panel appeared again.

This time, Zhan Fei can basically conclude that he is not sick, and this panel is not a hallucination. Has anyone heard of hallucinations appearing so regularly?It will appear every time you close your eyes for three seconds. If it is not a disease, then could it be said that it is a super power or something?

Zhan Fei was so ordinary in Bozhou University of Science and Technology that he couldn't even shoot a piece of meat. He was almost suffocating himself to death at the age when he was eating meat. Therefore, Zhan Fei was very interested in this thing that might make him extraordinary. Then, he looked at the panel carefully:

Character: Zhanfei 001, HP: 60, MP: 120

Strength: 5, Physical: 4, Intelligence: 8, Agility: 5, Energy: 6,

Magic attack/defense: 40/30, physical attack/defense: 10/8, hit/dodge: 10/10,

Sure enough, this is his alien character in Dou Po Continent. However, the original number of level eighty-nine has now become level zero, and various attributes have returned to their original state. In Dou Po Continent, the five-dimensional attributes of different combat professions have different increases.

For example, for aliens, the increase in magic brought by intelligence and energy is relatively large, while the increase in physical aspects brought by strength, agility, and physical strength is relatively small. Zhan Fei's account in the game also allocates points in the way of four wisdom and one essence.

But after seeing several of his attributes, Zhan Fei wanted to cry. The full value of these five attributes was all ten. Except for intelligence and energy, he failed in all of them, especially physical strength, which only had four points. His body was too bad now, right?In addition, agility and strength are only five points, which are below the average level.

Generally speaking, in terms of physical fitness of men, six points is considered average, eight points is excellent, if it is ten points, it is a national-level athlete, and if it is more than ten points, it is aliens like Bolt and Phelps.

At present, Zhan Fei's attributes are only good in intelligence. In other aspects, he has been somewhat degraded due to staying in the dormitory for two years in college. It seems that he will have to exercise hard in the future. After reading these attributes, Zhan Fei turned his attention to other parts of this panel.

In the upper right corner of the panel, there is a word "Shang", which is the official mall of Dou Po Continent. Various props needed for the entire game are sold in it. Some of the props inside are purchased with silver taels, and some are purchased with ingots. On the right side of the attribute panel, there is a package with thirty spaces in it, but it is empty.

At the bottom of the package, it is written that Zhan Fei owns silver coins, silver coins, ingots, and Yuanbao tickets. The silver coins and Yuanbao are both zero. The game starts with a gift of 100 taels of silver coins and 20 Yuanbao tickets. The difference between them is that the silver coins and Yuanbao tickets can be used to trade with players. Silver coins and Yuanbao tickets can only be traded with the official game and are bound.

But it seems that Zhan Fei is the only one playing this game in his own mind, so there is no difference between silver coins or banknotes to him.

After reading this, Zhan Fei's eyes were placed at the bottom of the attribute panel. Below, there were five options, namely mission system, mount system, spirit beast system, combat occupation, and life occupation. The mission system was empty, and the mount system and spirit beast system required level 30 to open, so they were dark gray and could not be clicked on.

Combat professions also require level ten to open, so they cannot be clicked in. Only life professions can be clicked in. After clicking in, Zhan Fei's face also showed a hint of joy. Now that he can't fight monsters and has no tasks, how can he upgrade?

Therefore, the combat professions, spirit beasts, and mount systems may not be available at all. If the life skills cannot be used, then the possession of this game character will not be of any help to you. Fortunately, the life professions can be used!
